title: Flatten the config
hints: Each nested dict is the same problem again, just smaller. Let the function (or an inner helper) call itself on it, and pass down the key path built so far.
Walk `config.items()`. Build the full key as `f"{prefix}{sep}{key}"` (or just `key` at the top). If the value `isinstance(value, dict)`, recurse into it; otherwise store `out[full_key] = value`.
